SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DECODE(KEY_9,' ',TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),SUBSTR(KEY_9,1,8)) AS SEND_DATE , DECODE(KEY_9,' ',TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'),SUBSTR(KEY_9,10,6)) AS SEND_TIME , TRXL.KEY_1 AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , TRXL.KEY_2 AS UNIT_PRICE FROM ICOMTRXL TRXL, ICOMBYIT BYIT WHERE TRXL.DOC_NAME = 'ATOB_PRICE' AND TRXL.TARGET = 'KRCHANG001' AND TRXL.KEY_10 = 'N' AND TRXL.TARGET = BYIT.BUYER AND TRXL.KEY_1 = BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND BYIT.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('T','N') AND BYIT.STATUS <> 'D' GROUP BY TRXL.KEY_1 , TRXL.KEY_2 , TRXL.KEY_9
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT '$G_RS.SEND_DATE$' as RECV_DATE , '$G_RS.SEND_TIME$' as RECV_TIME , '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$' as BUYER_ITEM_NO , $G_RS.UNIT_PRICE$ as UNIT_PRICE FROM DUAL
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = $G_RS.SEND_DATE$||' '||$G_RS.SEND_TIME$ , KEY_10 = 'Y' WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ATOB_PRICE' AND TARGET = 'KRCHANG001' AND KEY_10 = 'N' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$' AND KEY_2 = $G_RS.UNIT_PRICE$
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = $G_RS.SEND_DATE$||' '||$G_RS.SEND_TIME$ , KEY_10 = 'E' WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ATOB_PRICE' AND TARGET = 'KRCHANG001' AND KEY_10 = 'N' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$' AND KEY_2 = $G_RS.UNIT_PRICE$
